exercises.instructionEn: You don't have to fly to get from Britain to central Europe. Why not cross the English Channel by boat, or go through the Channel Tunnel?
exercises.instructionUz: Britaniyadan materik Yevropaga borish uchun samolyotda uchish shart emas. La-Mansh bo'g'ozidan kema bilan o'tsangiz-chi yoki tunnel orqali borsangiz-chi?
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — 'CULTURE CLIPS' BO'LIMINING
BIRINChI MAVZUSI.

  Mavzu: Britaniyadan materik Yevropaga
  qanday borish mumkin.


⚠ BET RAQAMI TIKLANDI:

  Photo File varaqlarida bet raqami yo'q
  edi (ular qirqib olinadigan varaqlar).

  Culture Clips'da raqamlash yana
  boshlanadi — 154-betdan.


KIRISh MATNI:

  'You don't have to fly to get from
   Britain to central Europe. Why not
   cross the English Channel by boat,
   or go through the Channel Tunnel?'


⚠⚠ 'DON'T HAVE TO' — MUHIM QOLIP:

  'You DON'T HAVE TO fly.'
     = Uchish ShART EMAS.
       (Uchsangiz ham bo'ladi, lekin
        majburiy emas.)

  ⚠⚠ 'MUSTN'T' BILAN ADAShTIRMANG!

     'You don't have to fly.'
        = uchish ShART EMAS (erkinlik)

     'You mustn't fly.'
        = uchish TAQIQLANADI (taqiq)

  ⚠ Bu — ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p xato
  qilinadigan juftliklardan biri.


⚠ 'WHY NOT ...?' — TAKLIF:

  'WHY NOT cross the Channel by boat?'
     = Bo'g'ozdan kema bilan o'tsangiz-chi?

  ⚠ 'Why not' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY
  shaklda, 'you' YO'Q:
     'Why not GO?'      ✓
     'Why not you go?'  ✗
     'Why not to go?'   ✗

  ⚠ 144-betdagi 'Why DON'T YOU go?' bilan
  ma'nosi bir xil, lekin qurilishi boshqa:
     'Why don't you GO?'  ('you' BOR)
     'Why not GO?'        ('you' YO'Q)


⚠ 'THE ENGLISH CHANNEL':

  = La-Mansh bo'g'ozi
  (Angliya bilan Fransiya orasidagi
   dengiz bo'g'ozi)

  ⚠ 'a channel' = bo'g'oz; kanal;
     telekanal

  ⚠ Fransuzlar uni 'La Manche' deydi.

  ⚠ 'the Channel Tunnel' = bo'g'oz osti
  tunneli. Xalq orasida 'the Chunnel'
  ('Channel' + 'tunnel') deb ham ataladi.


⚠ 'BY BOAT' — ARTIKLSIZ:

     by boat, by car, by train,
     by plane, by bus

  ⚠ Transport vositasi 'BY' bilan kelsa
  ARTIKL QO'YILMAYDI:
     'by boat'     ✓
     'by the boat' ✗

  ⚠ ISTISNO: 'ON FOOT' (piyoda) —
  'by foot' EMAS!


⚠ HALOL IZOH — SARLAVHA HAQIDA:

  Sarlavhada 'CENTRAL Europe'
  (Markaziy Yevropa) deyilgan.

  Lekin matn va xaritada faqat FRANSIYA
  va BELGIYA ko'rsatilgan — bular
  G'ARBIY Yevropa mamlakatlari.

  Britaniyaliklar 'materik Yevropa'
  ma'nosida ishlatgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a route      = yo'l, marshrut
  the English Channel = La-Mansh bo'g'ozi
  the Channel Tunnel = bo'g'oz osti tunneli
  to cross     = kesib o'tmoq
  to fly       = uchmoq
  a boat       = qayiq, kema
  don't have to = shart emas

exercises.instructionEn: 1  Pre-reading Activity. Look at the pictures and the map. Which of the following are true statements? Write T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: 1  O'qishdan oldingi mashq. Rasmlarga va xaritaga qarang. Quyidagilardan qaysilari to'g'ri? T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ BU — 'PRE-READING ACTIVITY'
(o'qishdan OLDINGI mashq).

  Maqsadi: matnni o'qishdan oldin
  RASMLAR va XARITAGA qarab taxmin
  qilish.

  ⚠ Xarita 155-betda.


⚠ NEGA 'PRE-READING' KERAK:

  Matnni o'qishdan oldin mavzu bilan
  tanishsangiz, o'qish OSONROQ bo'ladi —
  miya nimani kutishni biladi.


⚠ 'T' va 'F':

     T = TRUE  = to'g'ri
     F = FALSE = noto'g'ri


JAVOBLAR:

  1  F  — Dover ANGLIYADA
           (matnda: 'Dover, on the south
            coast of England')
  2  T  — Folkestone Angliyaning
           janubida (xaritada)
  3  T  — tunnel dengiz TUBI OSTIDAN
           o'tadi (155-bet: '40 metres
           below the seabed')


⚠ 'PRE-' QO'ShIMChASI:

     pre + reading  = o'qishdan OLDIN
     pre + view     = oldindan ko'rish
     pre + pare     = tayyorlamoq

  ⚠ 'pre-' = OLDIN
  ⚠ 'post-' = KEYIN (post-reading)

tasks.prompt: 1  Dover is in Belgium.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ NOTO'G'RI (F).

Matnda aniq yozilgan:
'Dover, on the south COAST OF ENGLAND'
= Dover Angliyaning janubiy sohilida.

⚠ Belgiyadagi portlar — Ostend va
Zeebrugge (xaritada ko'rinadi).

tasks.prompt: 2  Folkestone is in the south of England.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI (T).

155-betdagi xaritada Folkestone Dover
yonida, Angliyaning janubiy sohilida
turibdi.

⚠ Channel Tunnel aynan Folkestone'dan
boshlanadi.

tasks.prompt: 3  The Channel Tunnel goes under the seabed.
tasks.promptUz: Bo'g'oz osti tunneli dengiz tubi ostidan o'tadi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI (T).

155-betdagi matnda:
'The Channel Tunnel is 50 km long and
40 METRES BELOW THE SEABED.'

'the seabed' = dengiz tubi
('sea' + 'bed' — 'dengiz to'shagi').

exercises.instructionEn: 2  a) Read the texts and tick (✓) the correct box for the statements 1-6: Right / Wrong / Doesn't Say. Then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  a) Matnlarni o'qing va 1-6 gaplar uchun to'g'ri katakchani belgilang: To'g'ri / Noto'g'ri / Aytilmagan. So'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠⚠ MASHQ IKKI BETGA YOYILGAN:

  1, 2 va 6-gaplar → 154-betdagi
     DOVER matnidan
  3, 4 va 5-gaplar → 155-betdagi
     TUNNEL matni va FAKTLAR QUTISIDAN

  ⚠ Shuning uchun avval IKKALA matnni
  ham o'qing.


⚠⚠ UCH XIL JAVOB — ENG MUHIM MAHORAT:

  RIGHT (to'g'ri)
     Matnda shunday deyilgan.

  WRONG (noto'g'ri)
     Matnda BOShQAChA deyilgan —
     matn gapga QARShI chiqadi.

  DOESN'T SAY (aytilmagan)
     Matnda bu haqda UMUMAN gap yo'q.
     Rost bo'lishi ham, yolg'on bo'lishi
     ham mumkin — LEKIN MATN AYTMAGAN.

  ⚠⚠ ENG KO'P XATO: 'Doesn't Say' o'rniga
  'Wrong' belgilash.

  ⚠ QOIDA: matnda dalil YO'Q bo'lsa —
  'Doesn't Say'. O'zingiz bilgan narsa
  hisobga OLINMAYDI!


DOVER HAQIDAGI MATN (154-bet):

  'Dover, on the south coast of England,
   is one of the world's busiest PORTS.
   Every day lots of FERRIES and
   high-speed catamarans called "Seacats"
   arrive and leave. It's a SHORT trip
   across the English Channel to Calais
   and Dunkirk in France, or to Ostend
   and Zeebrugge in Belgium. A
   TRADITIONAL ferry takes 90 minutes
   from Dover to Calais, but a catamaran
   is much faster and can make the SAME
   journey in 35 minutes.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Angliyaning janubiy sohilidagi Dover —
   dunyodagi eng band portlardan biri. Har
   kuni ko'plab paromlar va "Seacat" deb
   ataladigan tezyurar katamaranlar kelib-
   ketadi. La-Mansh bo'g'ozi orqali
   Fransiyaning Kale va Dyunkerk shaharlariga
   yoki Belgiyaning Ostend va Zeebrugge
   shaharlariga qisqa sayohat. An'anaviy
   parom Doverdan Kalega 90 daqiqada boradi,
   lekin katamaran ancha tezroq va xuddi shu
   yo'lni 35 daqiqada bosib o'tadi.'


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  WRONG        (parom 90 daqiqa)
  2  RIGHT        (Seacat — katamaran)
  3  WRONG        (50 km UZUN, 40 metr
                   chuqur)
  4  DOESN'T SAY  (qaysi usul eng ommabop
                   ekani aytilmagan)
  5  WRONG        (1994-yilda ochilgan)
  6  RIGHT        (Ostend — Belgiyada)


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR (2a ning ikkinchi
  qismi):

  154-betda:
     Tunnel   = tunnel
     ports    = portlar
     ferries  = paromlar

  155-betda:
     seabed      = dengiz tubi
     expensive   = qimmat
     sightseeing = diqqatga sazovor
                   joylarni tomosha qilish

tasks.prompt: 1  It takes 35 minutes to travel from Dover to Calais by ferry.
tasks.promptUz: Doverdan Kalega parom bilan borish 35 daqiqa vaqt oladi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ NOTO'G'RI (Wrong).

Matnda:
'A traditional FERRY takes 90 MINUTES
from Dover to Calais, but a CATAMARAN
... in 35 MINUTES.'

⚠ TUZOQ: 35 daqiqa raqami matnda BOR,
lekin u KATAMARAN uchun, parom uchun emas!

⚠ Bunday tuzoqqa e'tibor bering: raqam
to'g'ri, lekin BOSHQA narsaga tegishli.

tasks.prompt: 2  A Seacat is a high-speed catamaran.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI (Right).

Matnda:
'high-speed catamarans CALLED "Seacats"'
= 'Seacat' deb ataladigan tezyurar
katamaranlar.

⚠ 'called' = deb ataladigan — nom berish
uchun ishlatiladi.

tasks.prompt: 3  The Channel Tunnel is 50km below the seabed.
tasks.promptUz: Bo'g'oz osti tunneli dengiz tubidan 50 km pastda.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ NOTO'G'RI (Wrong). Javob 155-betdagi
matnda:

'The Channel Tunnel is 50 KM LONG and
40 METRES BELOW the seabed.'

⚠ TUZOQ: 50 km — UZUNLIGI, chuqurligi
emas! Chuqurligi — 40 METR.

⚠ Ikki o'lchov ATAYLAB almashtirilgan.

tasks.prompt: 4  The most popular way to cross the Channel is by Seacat.
tasks.promptUz: Bo'g'ozdan o'tishning eng ommabop usuli — Seacat.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠⚠ AYTILMAGAN (Doesn't Say) — bu betdagi
ENG QIYIN band!

Ikkala matnda ham Seacat, parom va tunnel
TASVIRLANGAN, lekin QAYSI BIRI ENG OMMABOP
ekani HECH QAYERDA aytilmagan.

⚠ 'Wrong' deb belgilash — XATO. 'Wrong'
faqat matn gapga QARSHI chiqqanda
qo'yiladi.

⚠ QOIDA: matnda dalil yo'q → 'Doesn't Say'.

tasks.prompt: 5  The Channel Tunnel opened in 1995.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ NOTO'G'RI (Wrong). Javob 155-betdagi
FAKTLAR QUTISIDA:

'Since it opened in 1994, 57 million
people ... have travelled through the
Channel Tunnel.'

⚠ 1994-yil, 1995 emas.

⚠ E'TIBOR: javob asosiy matnda emas,
KICHIK QUTIDA yashiringan. Bunday
qutilarni ham o'qish kerak!

tasks.prompt: 6  Ostend is in Belgium.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI (Right).

Matnda:
'... or to OSTEND and Zeebrugge in
BELGIUM.'

⚠ 155-betdagi xaritada ham Ostend
Belgiya hududida ko'rsatilgan —
ikki manbadan tasdiqlanadi.

exercises.instructionEn: 2  b) Match the highlighted words to their opposites in the list: boring, long, different, modern, slower.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  b) Ta'kidlangan so'zlarni ro'yxatdagi zid ma'noli so'zlar bilan moslang: boring, long, different, modern, slower.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ TA'KIDLANGAN (ko'k rangda) SO'ZLAR
IKKI BETGA TARQALGAN:

  154-betda: short, traditional, same
  155-betda: quicker, exciting

  Ro'yxatda ham AYNAN 5 ta so'z bor —
  demak har biriga bittadan juft.


⚠ ZID MA'NOLI SO'Z = 'AN OPPOSITE'
  (yoki 'an antonym')


BARCHA JUFTLAR:

  short       ↔  long        (qisqa/uzun)
  traditional ↔  modern      (an'anaviy/
                              zamonaviy)
  same        ↔  different   (bir xil/
                              boshqa)
  quicker     ↔  slower      (tezroq/
                              sekinroq)
  exciting    ↔  boring      (qiziqarli/
                              zerikarli)


⚠ IKKI JUFT — QIYOSIY DARAJADA:

     'quicker' va 'slower'

  Ikkalasi ham '-ER' bilan tugaydi —
  QIYOSIY DARAJA (taqqoslash).

  ⚠ Shuning uchun javob ham '-er' bilan
  bo'lishi kerak:
     quicker ↔ slowER  ✓
     quicker ↔ slow    ✗


⚠ ZID MA'NO YASASHNING IKKI YO'LI:

  1) BUTUNLAY BOShQA SO'Z:
     short ↔ long
     same  ↔ different

  2) INKOR QO'ShIMChASI:
     possible  ↔ IMpossible
     happy     ↔ UNhappy
     polite    ↔ IMpolite
     correct   ↔ INcorrect

  ⚠ Bu betdagi barcha juftlar 1-turdan.

exercises.instructionEn: READING TEXT 2: If you don't like boats, why not go on a journey under the sea?
exercises.instructionUz: 2-MATN: Kemani yoqtirmasangiz, dengiz ostidan sayohat qilsangiz-chi?
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — 1-MAVZUNING IKKINChI BETI.

  Bu yerda IKKINChI MATN (tunnel haqida),
  XARITA va FAKTLAR QUTISI bor.

  ⚠ 154-betdagi 2a va 2b mashqlarining
  javoblari qisman shu betda.


IKKINChI MATN:

  'If you don't like boats, why not go on
   a journey under the sea? The Channel
   Tunnel is 50 km long and 40 metres
   below the SEABED. Getting from the
   port at Folkestone across to Coquelles
   near Calais is only a 35-minute train
   journey through the tunnel. It's more
   EXPENSIVE than a ferry, but QUICKER
   and much more EXCITING. Thanks to the
   Channel Tunnel, it is now possible to
   spend the day in Paris shopping and
   SIGHTSEEING, and be back in London in
   time for dinner in the evening!'


TARJIMASI:

  'Kemalarni yoqtirmasangiz, dengiz ostidan
   sayohat qilsangiz-chi? Bo'g'oz osti
   tunneli 50 km uzunlikda va dengiz tubidan
   40 metr pastda joylashgan. Folkeston
   portidan Kale yaqinidagi Kokellga o'tish —
   tunnel orqali atigi 35 daqiqalik poyezd
   safari. Bu paromdan qimmatroq, lekin
   tezroq va ancha qiziqarliroq. Bo'g'oz osti
   tunneli tufayli endi kunni Parijda xarid
   qilib va shahar tomosha qilib o'tkazish
   hamda kechki ovqatga ulgurib Londonga
   qaytish mumkin!'


FAKTLAR QUTISI:

  'Since it opened in 1994, 57 million
   people and 12,000 cats and dogs have
   travelled through the Channel Tunnel.'

  = '1994-yilda ochilganidan beri tunnel
     orqali 57 million odam va 12 000 mushuk
     va it sayohat qilgan.'

  ⚠ Bu quti 154-betdagi 5-gapning javobi:
  tunnel 1994-yilda ochilgan (1995 EMAS).

  ⚠ HALOL IZOH: '57 million' raqami kitob
  yozilgan davrga tegishli — yillar o'tishi
  bilan bu son ortib boradi.


⚠⚠ 'SINCE' + PRESENT PERFECT:

  'SINCE it opened in 1994, 57 million
   people HAVE TRAVELLED ...'

  ⚠ 'since' (... dan beri) — o'tmishda
  boshlanib, HOZIRGACHA davom etayotgan
  davr.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun fe'l PRESENT PERFECT
  ('have/has + 3-shakl'):
     'have TRAVELLED'  ✓
     'travelled'       ✗ (Past Simple)

  ⚠ 'SINCE' va 'FOR' farqi:
     SINCE + BOShLANISh NUQTASI
        since 1994, since Monday
     FOR   + DAVOMIYLIK
        for 30 years, for two hours


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR (2a mashqining
  ikkinchi qismi — 'explain the words in
  bold'):

  seabed
     'sea' + 'bed' = dengiz TUBI
     ⚠ 'bed' bu yerda 'to'shak' emas,
     'tub, yotoq' ma'nosida.

  expensive
     = qimmat
     ⚠ zid ma'nosi: 'cheap' (arzon)

  sightseeing
     'sight' + 'seeing' = diqqatga
     sazovor joylarni tomosha qilish
     ⚠ 'to go sightseeing' = shahar
     tomosha qilgani bormoq

  154-betdagi qalin so'zlar:
     Tunnel  = tunnel
     ports   = portlar
     ferries = paromlar


⚠ XARITADAGI JOYLAR:

  ANGLIYA (England):
     London      — poytaxt
     Folkestone  — tunnel boshlanadigan port
     Dover       — parom porti

  FRANSIYA (France):
     Coquelles   — tunnel chiqadigan joy
     Calais      — Kale porti
     Dunkirk     — Dyunkerk porti

  BELGIYA (Belgium):
     Ostend      — port
     Zeebrugge   — port

  ⚠ TUNNEL: Folkestone ↔ Coquelles
  ⚠ PAROM:  Dover ↔ Calais / Dunkirk /
            Ostend / Zeebrugge

  ⚠ E'TIBOR BERING: tunnel Doverdan EMAS,
  FOLKESTONE dan boshlanadi!


⚠ KOMPAS (xaritadagi):

  16 ta rumb ko'rsatilgan:
     N, NNE, NE, ENE, E, ESE, SE, SSE,
     S, SSW, SW, WSW, W, WNW, NW, NNW

  ⚠ 'NNE' = North-North-East
     (shimol-shimoli-sharq)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the seabed   = dengiz tubi
  expensive    = qimmat
  cheap        = arzon
  sightseeing  = shahar tomoshasi
  a tunnel     = tunnel
  since        = ... dan beri
  possible     = mumkin
  thanks to    = ... tufayli
  in time for  = ... ga ulgurib
  to spend the day = kunni o'tkazmoq

Ot oldidan sifat bo'lib kelganda o'lchov
BIRLIKDA qoladi va DEFIS qo'yiladi:

  'a 35-minutes journey'  ✗

MINUTES.' (bu yerda ko'plikda)

gapda:

                'MORE exciting'
  QISQA sifat → 'quickER'

darajani kuchaytiradi ('very' EMAS!).

⚠ 'expensive' va 'exciting' — 2b mashqidagi
ta'kidlangan so'zlar.

tasks.en: Thanks to the Channel Tunnel, it is now possible to spend the day in Paris.

tasks.note:
⚠ 'THANKS TO' = ... tufayli (YAXSHI natija).

⚠ Yomon natija uchun 'BECAUSE OF':
'Because of the rain, we stayed at home.'

exercises.instructionUz: 1-MATN — VANKUVER: Vankuver — Kanadadagi eng go'zal joylardan biri.
exercises.explanationUz:
BIRINChI MATN — VANCOUVER.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'Vancouver is one of the most beautiful
   places in Canada. It has CLEAN streets
   and green parks and great views of the
   Pacific Ocean, to the west and HUGE
   mountains to the east. Vancouver is an
   IDEAL city. One of its main
   ATTRACTIONS is Stanley Park, where
   there are SANDY beaches, lakes, and
   even Indian TOTEM POLES. You must also
   visit Canada Place. It has a CONFERENCE
   CENTRE a luxury hotel, a huge cinema
   and there are special events held there
   all year round.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Vankuver — Kanadadagi eng go'zal
   joylardan biri. Uning toza ko'chalari,
   yashil bog'lari, g'arbda Tinch okeanining
   ajoyib manzarasi va sharqda ulkan tog'lari
   bor. Vankuver — ideal shahar. Uning
   asosiy diqqatga sazovor joylaridan biri —
   Stenli Park; u yerda qumli plyajlar,
   ko'llar va hatto totem ustunlari bor.
   Canada Place'ga ham borishingiz kerak.
   U yerda konferensiya markazi, hashamatli
   mehmonxona, ulkan kinoteatr bor va yil
   davomida maxsus tadbirlar o'tkaziladi.'


⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI — VERGUL TUShIB QOLGAN:

  Kitobda: 'It has a conference centre a
            luxury hotel, a huge cinema...'

  ⚠ 'centre' dan keyin VERGUL YO'Q.

  To'g'risi:
     'a conference centre, a luxury hotel,
      a huge cinema'

  ⚠ Ro'yxatda har bandidan keyin vergul
  qo'yiladi.


⚠⚠ 'ONE OF THE MOST BEAUTIFUL PLACES':

  ⚠ 'one of the' dan keyin KO'PLIK:
     'one of the most beautiful placeS' ✓
     'one of the most beautiful place'  ✗

  ⚠ 142-betdagi 'one of the biggest zoos'
  bilan bir xil qoida.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  ideal
     = ideal, mukammal
     ⚠ O'qilishi: [ay-DIL] — 'i' harfi
     'ay' deb o'qiladi!

  attractions
     = diqqatga sazovor joylar
     ⚠ 'to attract' (jalb qilmoq) dan
     yasalgan

  sandy
     = qumli
     ⚠ 'sand' (qum) + '-y'

  totem poles
     = totem ustunlari
     ⚠ 'a pole' = ustun, qoziq

  conference centre
     = konferensiya markazi
     ⚠ 'centre' — Britaniya imlosi
     (AmE: 'center')


⚠ 'MUST' — QAT'IY TAVSIYA:

  'You MUST also visit Canada Place.'
     = Albatta borishingiz kerak.

  ⚠ Sayohat matnlarida 'must' MAJBURIYAT
  emas, KUChLI TAVSIYA bildiradi.

  ⚠ 144-betdagi 'should' dan kuchliroq.


⚠ 'ALL YEAR ROUND':

  = yil davomida, butun yil bo'yi

  ⚠ 'round' bu yerda 'davomida' ma'nosida.


⚠ 'TO THE WEST' va 'IN THE WEST':

  'the Pacific Ocean, TO THE WEST'
     = g'arb TOMONDA (shahardan tashqarida)

exercises.instructionEn: TEXT 2 - OTTAWA: Ottawa, the capital city of Canada, is a wonderful mixture of old and new buildings.
exercises.instructionUz: 2-MATN — OTTAVA: Ottava, Kanadaning poytaxti, eski va yangi binolarning ajoyib uyg'unligi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKINChI MATN — OTTAWA.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'Ottawa, the capital city of Canada, is
   a wonderful MIXTURE of old and new
   buildings. This green city is a
   CULTURAL and historical centre for
   Canada. The people are friendly and
   speak both French and English.
   Parliament Hill is a popular tourist
   SPOT where visitors can watch MILITARY
   PARADES. Ottawa is also the HOME of
   Canada's National Gallery. It is
   SURROUNDED by BEAUTIFUL gardens.
   Inside, visitors can see over 25,000 of
   the world's most TREASURED works of
   art. With more than twenty-five other
   museums, sixty annual festivals and a
   wildlife park, Ottawa is a great city
   to visit.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Ottava, Kanadaning poytaxti, eski va
   yangi binolarning ajoyib uyg'unligi.
   Bu yashil shahar Kanadaning madaniy va
   tarixiy markazi. Odamlari mehribon, ham
   fransuz, ham ingliz tilida gapirishadi.
   Parlament tepaligi — sayyohlar sevadigan
   joy; u yerda harbiy paradlarni tomosha
   qilish mumkin. Ottava — Kanada Milliy
   galereyasining ham uyi. U go'zal bog'lar
   bilan o'ralgan. Ichkarida tashrif
   buyuruvchilar dunyoning eng qadrli 25 000
   dan ortiq san'at asarini ko'rishlari
   mumkin. Yigirma beshdan ortiq boshqa
   muzey, oltmishta yillik bayram va tabiat
   bog'i bilan Ottava — borishga arziydigan
   ajoyib shahar.'


⚠⚠ ENG NOZIK GAP (156-bet, 5-band):

  'With MORE THAN twenty-five other
   museums, SIXTY annual festivals and a
   wildlife park...'

  ⚠ 'more than' faqat MUZEYLARGA tegishli.
  ⚠ Bayramlar ANIQ oltmishta.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 'over 60 festivals'
  gapi NOTO'G'RI (F).


⚠ VERGULLI IZOH:

  'Ottawa, THE CAPITAL CITY OF CANADA, is
   a wonderful mixture...'

  ⚠ Ikki vergul orasidagi qism — IZOH.
  ⚠ Ikkala vergul ham kerak.

  ⚠ 141-betdagi 'Mr Thomas, her teacher,
  gave...' bilan bir xil qolip.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  mixture
     = aralashma, uyg'unlik
     ⚠ 'to mix' (aralashtirmoq) +
     '-ture'

  cultural
     = madaniy
     ⚠ 'culture' (madaniyat) + '-al'

  spot
     = joy, nuqta
     ⚠ 'a tourist spot' = sayyohlar
     joyi
     ⚠ 'a spot' ning boshqa ma'nosi:
     dog', nuqta (kiyimdagi)

  military parades
     = harbiy paradlar

  home
     = uy; VATAN, MAKON
     ⚠ 'the home OF' = ... ning makoni
     (bu yerda 'uy' emas!)

  surrounded
     = o'ralgan
     ⚠ 'to surround' (o'rab olmoq)

  treasured
     = qadrli, e'zozlangan
     ⚠ 'a treasure' (xazina) dan


⚠ 'BOTH ... AND ...':

  'speak BOTH French AND English'
     = ham fransuz, ham ingliz tilida

  ⚠ Ikkalasini birga ta'kidlaydi.

  ⚠ Shu qatordagilar:
     both ... and ...   — ham, ham
     either ... or ...  — yo, yo
     neither ... nor ...— na, na


⚠ 'PEOPLE' — HAR DOIM KO'PLIK:

  'The people ARE friendly and SPEAK...'

  ⚠ 'people is' ✗
  ⚠ 'peoples' faqat XALQLAR ma'nosida.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a mixture    = aralashma, uyg'unlik
  to mix       = aralashtirmoq
  cultural     = madaniy
  historical   = tarixiy
  a spot       = joy, nuqta
  a parade     = parad
  to surround  = o'rab olmoq
  a treasure   = xazina
  treasured    = qadrli
  a work of art = san'at asari
  annual       = yillik
  a wildlife park = tabiat bog'i
  a visitor    = tashrif buyuruvchi
  friendly     = mehribon

exercises.instructionEn: TEXT 3 - MONTREAL: The city of Montreal is sometimes called the Paris of North America.
exercises.instructionUz: 3-MATN — MONREAL: Monreal shahri ba'zan Shimoliy Amerikaning Parijchasi deb ataladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
UChINChI MATN — MONTREAL.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'The city of Montreal is sometimes
   called the Paris of North America. Two
   thirds of the people speak French. The
   area of Old Montreal is very POPULAR
   with tourists because of its NARROW
   streets, OLD buildings and
   European-style cafes and restaurants.
   In the Botanical Gardens there are over
   22,000 types of PLANTS and flowers from
   all over the world. The Chinese Garden
   is beautiful and it has a huge
   COLOURFUL pagoda.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Monreal shahri ba'zan Shimoliy
   Amerikaning Parijchasi deb ataladi.
   Aholining uchdan ikki qismi fransuz
   tilida gapiradi. Eski Monreal hududi
   sayyohlar orasida juda mashhur — uning
   tor ko'chalari, qadimiy binolari va
   Yevropa uslubidagi kafe-restoranlari
   tufayli. Botanika bog'ida dunyoning
   turli burchaklaridan keltirilgan 22 000
   dan ortiq turdagi o'simlik va gul bor.
   Xitoy bog'i go'zal va u yerda ulkan
   rang-barang pagoda bor.'


⚠⚠ 'TWO THIRDS' — KASR SONLAR:

  'TWO THIRDS of the people'
     = aholining UChDAN IKKI qismi

  ⚠ Kasr sonlar qanday o'qiladi:
     1/2  = a half
     1/3  = a third
     2/3  = two thirdS      ⚠ KO'PLIK!
     1/4  = a quarter
     3/4  = three quarterS  ⚠ KO'PLIK!

  ⚠ QOIDA: yuqoridagi son 1 dan katta
  bo'lsa, pastdagisi KO'PLIKDA:
     two thirdS, three quarterS


⚠ 'BECAUSE OF' + OT:

  'popular ... BECAUSE OF its narrow
   streets'

  ⚠ 'because OF' dan keyin OT keladi;
  ⚠ 'because' dan keyin GAP keladi:
     'because the streets are narrow'

  ⚠ 155-betdagi 'thanks to' bilan
  solishtiring: 'thanks to' — faqat
  YAXShI natija uchun.


⚠ 'IS CALLED' — MAJHUL NISBAT:

  'Montreal IS CALLED the Paris of North
   America.'
     = Monreal ... deb ATALADI.

  ⚠ 'is/are + 3-shakl' — ish kim tomonidan
  bajarilgani muhim emas.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  popular
     = mashhur, ommabop
     ⚠ 'popular WITH' — 'with' bilan!
     ('popular by' ✗)

  narrow
     = tor
     ⚠ zid ma'nosi: 'wide' (keng)

  plants
     = o'simliklar
     ⚠ 'a plant' ning boshqa ma'nosi:
     zavod, fabrika


⚠ 'EUROPEAN-STYLE' — QO'ShMA SIFAT:

  'European-style cafes'
     = Yevropa uslubidagi kafelar

  ⚠ Ot oldidan kelgan qo'shma sifat
  DEFIS bilan yoziladi.

  ⚠ 155-betdagi 'a 35-minute journey'
  bilan bir xil qoida.


⚠ 'AN EUROPEAN' EMAS, 'A EUROPEAN'!

  'European' 'yu-' tovushi bilan
  boshlanadi — UNDOSh kabi.

     'a European city'  ✓
     'an European city' ✗

  ⚠ Shu kabi: a university, a uniform.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  popular      = mashhur, ommabop
  narrow       = tor
  wide         = keng
  a plant      = o'simlik; zavod
  botanical    = botanika
  a type       = tur, xil
  an area      = hudud
  two thirds   = uchdan ikki
  because of   = ... tufayli
  European-style = Yevropa uslubidagi
  all over the world = butun dunyodan

⚠ 'SPEAKING' — GAPIRISh MAShQI.


BIRINChI SAVOL:
  'Which of these cities would you like to
   visit, and why?'

  ⚠⚠ 'WOULD LIKE TO' = xohlardim

     'I WOULD LIKE TO visit...'
     'I'D LIKE TO visit...'  (qisqartma)

  ⚠ 'would like' — 'want' dan MULOYIMROQ.

  ⚠ 'would like' dan keyin HAR DOIM 'TO':
     'I'd like TO visit'  ✓
     'I'd like visit'     ✗
     'I'd like visiting'  ✗

  ⚠ SOLIShTIRING: 'I LIKE visiting museums'
  (umuman yoqadi) — bu yerda '-ing'.

  NAMUNA JAVOB:
     'I would like to visit Vancouver
      because it has clean streets, huge
      mountains and sandy beaches. I love
      the sea, so Stanley Park is perfect
      for me.'


IKKINChI SAVOL:
  'Name three cities in your country.
   Which one is your favourite? What do
   you like about it? What can you see and
   do there?'

  ⚠ Bu — TO'RT qismli savol. Javob ham
  to'rt qismdan iborat bo'lsin.

  NAMUNA JAVOB (O'zbekiston haqida):

     'There are many beautiful cities in
      Uzbekistan. Three of them are
      Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva.

      My favourite is Samarkand. I like it
      because it is very old and it has
      wonderful blue buildings.

      In Samarkand you can see Registan
      Square, the Bibi-Khanym Mosque and
      the Gur-e-Amir. You can also walk
      in the old streets and buy souvenirs
      at the bazaar.'

  ⚠ 'Name' bu yerda FE'L: 'nomlang, ayting'.


⚠ 'FAVOURITE' — BRITANIYA IMLOSI:

     BrE: favourite  ('u' bilan)
     AmE: favorite

  ⚠ 'colour/color' bilan bir xil qoida.


⚠ MUHOKAMA UChUN FOYDALI IBORALAR:

  'I'd like to visit ... because ...'
  'My favourite city is ...'
  'What I like about it is ...'
  'You can see ... and you can do ...'
  'It is famous for ...'


⚠ 'FAMOUS FOR' — 'BY' EMAS:

  'Samarkand is FAMOUS FOR its
   architecture.'
     = Samarqand me'morchiligi bilan
       mashhur.

  ⚠ 'famous by' ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  would like to = ... qilishni xohlardim
  favourite    = sevimli
  to name      = nomlamoq, aytmoq
  famous for   = ... bilan mashhur
  a square     = maydon
  a mosque     = masjid
  a souvenir   = sovg'a, esdalik
  architecture = me'morchilik

exercises.instructionUz: MATN: Hamma britaniyaliklar choy ichishini biladi, lekin ular kuniga 165 million piyola ichishini bilarmidingiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN:

  'Everybody knows that the British drink
   tea, but did you know that they drink
   around 165 MILLION cups every day? Tea
   is not just a drink, it is a tradition,
   and is PART of the history and CULTURE
   of the UK.

   Afternoon tea is a POPULAR tradition
   that started in the early 1800s when
   people had tea parties in their homes
   or went out to tea shops or tea rooms
   at around 4 o'clock in the afternoon.
   Today, people continue this tradition
   and tea is served with a light meal of
   sandwiches, biscuits, cream cakes or
   fruit cake. In some parts of Britain,
   afternoon tea is called high tea and
   usually INCLUDES a hot dish. It is
   SIMILAR to a cooked breakfast, and
   foods such as kippers or eggs with
   toast as well as cold meats are served.

   Tea breaks are another tradition that
   have become a part of daily life. In
   the past, when workers began their day
   at about 6am, they took a break in the
   morning at around 11am to drink tea and
   have a light SNACK. Today many people
   call this "elevenses" and have a cup of
   tea and a biscuit.

   Nowadays, a wide VARIETY of different
   teas are available and different blends
   are drunk at different times. English
   breakfast tea is taken in the morning
   because it has a strong FLAVOUR and it
   wakes you up ready for the day.
   Darjeeling from India and Earl Grey
   from China are MILD and are best drunk
   with afternoon tea. Herbal and fruit
   teas are popular and are drunk at any
   time of the day.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Hamma britaniyaliklar choy ichishini
   biladi, lekin ular kuniga taxminan 165
   million piyola ichishini bilarmidingiz?
   Choy shunchaki ichimlik emas — u an'ana,
   Britaniya tarixi va madaniyatining bir
   qismi.

   Tushdan keyingi choy — 1800-yillar boshida
   boshlangan mashhur an'ana; o'shanda
   odamlar uylarida choy ziyofati qilishar
   yoki tushdan keyin soat to'rtlarda choyxona
   va choy zallariga borishardi. Bugun ham bu
   an'ana davom etadi: choy buterbrod,
   pechene, kremli tort yoki mevali tort bilan
   beriladi. Britaniyaning ba'zi joylarida
   tushdan keyingi choy "high tea" deb
   ataladi va odatda issiq taom ham bo'ladi.
   U pishirilgan nonushtaga o'xshaydi: dudlangan
   seld yoki tuxum-tost, shuningdek sovuq
   go'shtlar beriladi.

   Choy tanaffusi — kundalik hayotga singib
   ketgan yana bir an'ana. Ilgari ishchilar
   kunini ertalab soat 6 larda boshlaganda,
   soat 11 larda tanaffus qilib choy ichishar
   va yengil gazak qilishardi. Bugun ko'pchilik
   buni "elevenses" deb ataydi va bir piyola
   choy bilan pechene yeydi.

   Hozirgi kunda juda ko'p turdagi choylar bor
   va turli aralashmalar turli vaqtda ichiladi.
   Ingliz nonushta choyi ertalab ichiladi,
   chunki uning ta'mi kuchli va sizni kunga
   tayyor holda uyg'otadi. Hindistondan
   keladigan Darjiling va Xitoydan keladigan
   Earl Grey yumshoq bo'lib, tushdan keyingi
   choyga eng mos keladi. O't-o'lan va mevali
   choylar ham mashhur, ular kunning istalgan
   paytida ichiladi.'


⚠ UChTA CHOY AN'ANASI:

  1) AFTERNOON TEA (tushdan keyingi choy)
     — soat 4 larda, yengil taom bilan

  2) HIGH TEA
     — issiq taom bilan (ba'zi hududlarda)

  3) TEA BREAK / ELEVENSES
     — soat 11 larda tanaffus


⚠ HALOL IZOH — 'AFTERNOON TEA' va
  'HIGH TEA':

  Kitob 'afternoon tea is called high tea'
  deb yozgan.

  Aslida bu ikki narsa tarixan BOShQA:
     'afternoon tea' — soat 4 larda
        YENGIL taom (an'anaviy ravishda
        badavlat oilalarda)
     'high tea' — ishchilar oilasida
        KEChQURUNGI ISSIQ ovqat

  ⚠ Kitob ularni yaqinlashtirib bergan,
  lekin 'high tea' da ISSIQ TAOM borligini
  to'g'ri aytgan.


⚠ HALOL IZOH — 'EARL GREY FROM CHINA':

  Darjeeling — haqiqatan Hindistondagi
  hudud nomi.

  Earl Grey esa HUDUD EMAS — bu
  ARALAShMA nomi: qora choyga bergamot
  moyi qo'shiladi.

  ⚠ An'anaviy ravishda xitoy choyi
  asosida tayyorlanadi, shuning uchun
  kitob 'from China' deb yozgan.


⚠ 'ELEVENSES' — QIZIQ SO'Z:

  'eleven' (11) + '-es'

  = soat 11 dagi choy tanaffusi

  ⚠ Faqat Britaniyada ishlatiladi.
  ⚠ Sonlardan yasalgan kam sonli
  so'zlardan biri.


⚠ 'THE BRITISH' — XALQ NOMI:

  'THE British DRINK tea' — KO'PLIK!

  ⚠ 'the' + millat sifati = butun xalq:
     the British  — britaniyaliklar
     the French   — fransuzlar
     the Chinese  — xitoyliklar

  ⚠ Fe'l KO'PLIKDA: 'the British ARE',
  'the British DRINK' ('drinks' ✗).


⚠ MAJHUL NISBAT (matnda juda ko'p):

     'tea IS SERVED with...'
     'foods ARE SERVED'
     'different blends ARE DRUNK'
     'English breakfast tea IS TAKEN'

  ⚠ Qolip: 'is/are' + 3-ShAKL

  ⚠ Kim bajarayotgani muhim emas —
  ish MUHIM.

  ⚠ 'drink' ning 3-shakli — 'DRUNK'
  (drink - drank - drunk).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a tradition = an'ana
  culture     = madaniyat
  to include  = o'z ichiga olmoq
  similar to  = ... ga o'xshash
  a snack     = yengil gazak
  a variety of = turli-tuman
  a blend     = aralashma
  flavour     = ta'm
  mild        = yumshoq (ta'm)
  strong      = kuchli
  herbal      = o't-o'lanli
  available   = mavjud, topiladi
  a tea break = choy tanaffusi
  elevenses   = soat 11 dagi choy
  a hot dish  = issiq taom
  as well as  = shuningdek

exercises.instructionEn: Speaking:  • Do people in your country drink tea or coffee? What is your national drink?  • Do you have any unusual meals like high tea?
exercises.instructionUz: Gapirish:  • Sizning mamlakatingizda odamlar choy ichishadimi yoki qahva? Milliy ichimligingiz nima?  • Sizda 'high tea' kabi g'ayrioddiy taomlar bormi?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'SPEAKING' — GAPIRISh MAShQI.


BIRINChI SAVOL:
  'Do people in your country drink tea or
   coffee? What is your national drink?'

  ⚠ O'ZBEKISTON UChUN JAVOB:

  Bu savol bizga juda mos keladi — chunki
  O'zbekistonda ham ChOY milliy ichimlik.

  NAMUNA JAVOB:

     'In Uzbekistan people drink tea. Tea
      is our national drink, just like in
      Britain.

      We drink green tea and black tea. In
      summer people usually drink green
      tea because it is refreshing.

      But there is a big difference: we
      DON'T put milk in our tea. British
      people always add milk and sugar. We
      drink tea from a small bowl called a
      "piyola", not from a cup with a
      handle.

      Tea is very important for guests. When
      someone visits our home, we always
      offer them tea first.'


IKKINChI SAVOL:
  'Do you have any unusual meals like high
   tea?'

  NAMUNA JAVOB:

     'We don't have high tea, but we have
      our own traditions.

      For example, we have "osh" (plov).
      It is a big meal of rice, meat and
      carrots. People often eat it at
      weddings and on special days.

      There is also a tradition called
      "nahorgi osh" - morning plov. People
      eat it very early in the morning,
      at about 6 or 7 o'clock. Hundreds of
      guests come. It is unusual because
      most people don't eat a big meal so
      early!'

  ⚠ 'nahorgi osh' — 'high tea' kabi
  g'ayrioddiy taom: odatdagidan boshqa
  vaqtda yeyiladi. Savolga juda mos javob.


⚠⚠ 'DO YOU HAVE ANY ...?':

  ⚠ SO'ROQ va INKOR gaplarda 'ANY';
  ⚠ TASDIQ gaplarda 'SOME':

     'Do you have ANY unusual meals?'  ✓
     'We have SOME traditions.'        ✓
     'We don't have ANY biscuits.'     ✓


⚠ 'LIKE' — UCh MA'NO:

  1) YOQTIRMOQ (fe'l):
     'I like tea.'

  2) KABI, O'XShASh (predlog):
     'unusual meals LIKE high tea'
     ← bu yerda shu ma'noda

  3) QANAQA (savolda):
     'What is it LIKE?' = U qanaqa?


⚠ 'NATIONAL' — YOZILIShI:

  'nation' (millat) + '-al'

     nation    → national
     tradition → traditional
     culture   → cultural

  ⚠ 'a national drink' = milliy ichimlik


⚠ MUHOKAMA UChUN FOYDALI IBORALAR:

  'In my country, people usually ...'
  'Our national drink is ...'
  'We have a tradition called ...'
  'It is similar to ... , but ...'
  'The main difference is that ...'
  'For example, ...'


⚠ TAQQOSLASh UChUN:

     'similar to'   = ... ga o'xshash
     'different from' = ... dan farqli
     ⚠ 'different FROM' — 'different than'
     EMAS (Britaniyada).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  national     = milliy
  a nation     = millat
  unusual      = g'ayrioddiy
  usual        = odatdagi
  a difference = farq
  different from = ... dan farqli
  to offer     = taklif qilmoq
  a guest      = mehmon
  refreshing   = tetiklashtiruvchi
  a handle     = dasta

exercises.instructionEn: READING TEXT 1 - NEW YORK: Did you know that there are more Chinese people living in the United States than in any other country outside of Asia?
exercises.instructionUz: 1-MATN — NYU-YORK: Osiyodan tashqarida boshqa hech qaysi mamlakatda AQShdagichalik ko'p xitoylik yashamasligini bilarmidingiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
BIRINChI MATN — NYU-YORK ChINATOWN'i.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'Did you know that there are more
   Chinese people living in the United
   States than in any other country
   outside of Asia? Or that America's
   LARGEST Chinese community is BASED in
   New York City's very own Chinatown?
   Any visitor to Manhattan's east side
   will feel as if they are in another
   world. It's a HUGE area with hundreds
   of Chinese restaurants where you can
   try DELICIOUS ORIENTAL dishes. Visitors
   enjoy walking along the WINDING streets
   full of colourful shops decorated with
   oriental carvings and images. There are
   also fruit, vegetable, meat and fish
   markets, selling everything you need to
   make your own Chinese meal.

   New York City's Chinatown really COMES
   TO LIFE during the Chinese New Year
   celebrations. The streets are CROWDED
   with people of all nationalities
   watching the AMAZING dragon and lion
   dances and admiring the INCREDIBLE
   costumes. Traditionally, Chinese
   shopkeepers must pay the lion dancers
   so that their shop has a good year. The
   more money they pay, the more luck they
   will have.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Osiyodan tashqarida boshqa hech qaysi
   mamlakatda AQShdagichalik ko'p xitoylik
   yashamasligini bilarmidingiz? Yoki
   Amerikaning eng katta xitoy jamoasi
   aynan Nyu-Yorkning o'z Chinatown'ida
   joylashganini? Manxettenning sharqiy
   qismiga kelgan har qanday mehmon o'zini
   boshqa dunyoda his qiladi. Bu — yuzlab
   xitoy restoranlari bo'lgan ulkan hudud;
   u yerda mazali sharq taomlarini tatib
   ko'rish mumkin. Mehmonlar sharq o'ymalari
   va tasvirlari bilan bezatilgan rang-barang
   do'konlarga to'la egri-bugri ko'chalarda
   sayr qilishni yoqtiradi. Bundan tashqari
   meva, sabzavot, go'sht va baliq bozorlari
   bor — o'zingiz xitoy taomi tayyorlashingiz
   uchun kerak bo'lgan hamma narsa sotiladi.

   Nyu-York Chinatown'i Xitoy Yangi yili
   nishonlanganda haqiqatan jonlanadi.
   Ko'chalar turli millat odamlari bilan
   to'lib ketadi: ular ajoyib ajdaho va sher
   raqslarini tomosha qilishadi, hayratlanarli
   liboslarga qoyil qolishadi. An'anaga ko'ra,
   xitoylik do'kondorlar sher raqqoslariga pul
   berishlari kerak — shunda do'konlari yaxshi
   yil o'tkazadi. Qancha ko'p pul bersalar,
   shuncha ko'p omad keladi.'


⚠⚠ 'THE MORE ..., THE MORE ...':

  'THE MORE money they pay, THE MORE luck
   they will have.'
     = Qancha ko'p pul bersalar, shuncha
       ko'p omad keladi.

  ⚠ Bu — juda muhim qolip:
     'THE + qiyosiy daraja, THE + qiyosiy
      daraja'

  Boshqa misollar:
     'The bigger, the better.'
        = Qancha katta bo'lsa, shuncha
          yaxshi.
     'The more you study, the more you
      learn.'
     'The sooner, the better.'

  ⚠ Har ikkala qismda ham 'THE' KERAK!


⚠ 'AS IF' — GO'YO:

  'will feel AS IF they are in another
   world'
     = o'zini go'yo boshqa dunyoda his
       qiladi

  ⚠ 'as if' = go'yo, xuddi ... kabi.


⚠ 'SO THAT' — MAQSAD:

  'must pay the lion dancers SO THAT
   their shop has a good year'
     = ... shunda do'konlari yaxshi yil
       o'tkazadi

  ⚠ 'so that' = ... uchun, shunda
  (MAQSAD bildiradi).


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR (2c mashqi uchun):

  based
     = joylashgan
     ⚠ 'a base' (asos, baza) dan

  oriental
     = sharqona
     ⚠ ESKI ATAMA — pastdagi izohga qarang

  winding
     = egri-bugri, buralgan
     ⚠ 'to wind' [waynd] = burmoq

exercises.instructionUz: Gapirish:  • Mamlakatingizda yashovchi odamlarning asosiy millatlari qaysilar?  • Yana qanday millatlar yashaydi? Ular qanday yashashadi?  • Yangi yilni qanday nishonlaysiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ UChTA MUHOKAMA SAVOLI.


BIRINChI va IKKINChI SAVOL —
MILLATLAR HAQIDA:

  NAMUNA JAVOB (O'zbekiston haqida):

     'The main nationality in Uzbekistan is
      Uzbek. Most people in my country are
      Uzbek and they speak Uzbek.

      But many other nationalities live
      here too. There are Russians, Tajiks,
      Kazakhs, Karakalpaks, Koreans, Tatars
      and others.

      They live together in the same
      cities and villages. Many of them
      speak two or three languages. They
      celebrate their own holidays, but
      they also celebrate Uzbek holidays
      like Navruz.

      Tashkent is a very mixed city -
      just like New York or London.'

  ⚠ Oxirgi gap savolni MATN bilan bog'laydi
  — bu javobni kuchli qiladi.


UChINChI SAVOL — YANGI YIL:

  NAMUNA JAVOB:

     'In Uzbekistan we celebrate New Year
      on the 31st of December. We decorate
      a New Year tree at home.

      The family sits together at a big
      table with a lot of food. At midnight
      we watch fireworks and say "Happy New
      Year!"

      Children get presents from Qorbobo -
      he is like Father Christmas.

      We also have another new year called
      NAVRUZ on the 21st of March. It is
      the first day of spring. People cook
      sumalak - a sweet dish made from
      wheat. It takes all night to cook it.'

  ⚠ NAVRUZ — juda yaxshi javob, chunki:
     • u ham YANGI YIL
     • u ham OY/QUYOSh taqvimiga bog'liq
       (xuddi Xitoy Yangi yili kabi!)
     • uning ham o'z maxsus taomi bor


⚠⚠ MILLAT NOMLARI — BOSh HARF BILAN!

     Uzbek, Russian, Tajik, Kazakh,
     Korean, Chinese, English

  ⚠ Ingliz tilida millat, til va mamlakat
  nomlari HAR DOIM BOSh HARF bilan
  yoziladi — gap o'rtasida ham!

  ⚠ O'zbek tilida esa kichik harf bilan:
  'o'zbek', 'rus', 'xitoy'.


⚠ 'NATIONALITY' va 'NATION':

     'a nation' = millat, xalq; davlat
     'a nationality' = millat, fuqarolik

  ⚠ 'What nationality are you?'
     = Siz qaysi millatdansiz?
  ⚠ Javob: 'I am Uzbek.' (artiklsiz)


⚠ 'TO CELEBRATE' + TO'G'RIDAN:

     'celebrate New Year'  ✓
     'celebrate ON New Year' ✗

  ⚠ Lekin SANA bilan 'ON':
     'on the 31st of December'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a nationality = millat
  to celebrate  = nishonlamoq
  a celebration = tantana
  a holiday     = bayram
  mixed         = aralash
  a tradition   = an'ana
  a present     = sovg'a
  midnight      = yarim tun

exercises.instructionEn: READING TEXT 2 - LONDON: London's Chinatown is in the Gerrard Street area in the city centre.
exercises.instructionUz: 2-MATN — LONDON: London Chinatown'i shahar markazidagi Gerrard Street atrofida joylashgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKINChI MATN — LONDON ChINATOWN'i.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'London's Chinatown is in the Gerrard
   Street area in the city centre. The
   Chinese Gate, which is a beautiful
   oriental entrance to Chinatown, is
   green and red and people see it as a
   SYMBOL of the success of the area.
   There is also a pavilion and no cars
   are allowed in the area. The streets
   are full of Chinese restaurants, food
   stores and specialist shops. Although
   it is called Chinatown, these
   BUSINESSES are from all over the Far
   East, including Thailand, Indonesia,
   Japan and Hong Kong. The area has
   become a MAJOR tourist attraction and
   part of London's culture.

   Britain's Chinese community celebrate
   Chinese New Year in style. London's
   Chinatown is DECORATED with lanterns
   and flags and the sound of noisy
   firecrackers fills the air. The whole
   area becomes a huge market with STALLS
   selling everything from CHEAP souvenirs
   to ANTIQUE Chinese vases. As in New
   York and all over the world, the lion
   dance is the main FEATURE of the
   celebration. However, there are many
   other special Chinese traditions. For
   example, children receive gifts of
   money in red packets with symbols on
   them to bring good luck.'


TARJIMASI:

  'London Chinatown'i shahar markazidagi
   Gerrard Street atrofida joylashgan. Xitoy
   darvozasi — Chinatown'ga olib kiruvchi
   go'zal sharq uslubidagi kirish joyi;
   u yashil va qizil rangda va odamlar uni
   hududning muvaffaqiyati ramzi deb
   bilishadi. Bu yerda pavilyon ham bor va
   hududga mashinalar kirishi taqiqlangan.
   Ko'chalar xitoy restoranlari, oziq-ovqat
   do'konlari va maxsus do'konlarga to'la.
   Garchi u Chinatown deb atalsa-da, bu
   korxonalar butun Uzoq Sharqdan — jumladan
   Tailand, Indoneziya, Yaponiya va
   Gonkongdan. Bu hudud yirik sayyohlik
   markaziga va London madaniyatining bir
   qismiga aylangan.

   Britaniyaning xitoy jamoasi Xitoy Yangi
   yilini dabdaba bilan nishonlaydi. London
   Chinatown'i fonus va bayroqlar bilan
   bezatiladi, havoni shovqinli petardalar
   ovozi to'ldiradi. Butun hudud ulkan
   bozorga aylanadi: rastalarda arzon
   esdaliklardan tortib qadimiy xitoy
   guldonlarigacha hamma narsa sotiladi.
   Nyu-Yorkdagi va butun dunyodagi kabi,
   sherlar raqsi bayramning asosiy qismi
   hisoblanadi. Biroq boshqa ko'plab maxsus
   xitoy an'analari ham bor. Masalan, bolalar
   omad keltirsin deb, ustida ramzlar bo'lgan
   qizil pakatlarda pul sovg'a olishadi.'


⚠⚠ 'WHICH' BILAN IZOH:

  'The Chinese Gate, WHICH IS a beautiful
   oriental entrance to Chinatown, is
   green and red...'

  ⚠ Ikki vergul orasidagi qism — IZOH
  (darvoza nima ekanini tushuntiradi).

  ⚠ EGA: 'The Chinese Gate'
     KESIM: 'is green and red'
  Izohni olib tashlasak ham gap to'liq
  qoladi.

  ⚠ 141 va 157-betlarda VERGUL bilan izoh
  bor edi; bu yerda 'WHICH' qo'shilgan.

  ⚠ 'which' — NARSA uchun;
     'who' — ODAM uchun.


⚠ 'ALTHOUGH' — GARChI:

  'ALTHOUGH it is called Chinatown, these
   businesses are from all over the Far
   East.'
     = Garchi u Chinatown deb atalsa-da,
       bu korxonalar butun Uzoq Sharqdan.

exercises.instructionUz: 1-MATN — LORD MER SAYLI: 1215-yildan beri davom etayotgan rang-barang London an'anasi.
exercises.explanationUz:
BIRINChI MATN — THE LORD MAYOR'S SHOW.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'The Lord Mayor's Show is a colourful
   London tradition which started in 1215
   and takes place every November. The
   Lord MAYOR is the person who makes
   important DECISIONS about the city.

   During the show he travels through
   central London in a gold coach at the
   front of a large PARADE. There are
   soldiers, marching bands, horses and
   brightly-coloured floats in the parade.
   People wear beautiful COSTUMES and
   follow the coach as they listen to the
   BANDS playing.

   The whole PROCESSION is nearly four
   kilometres long. It is the largest
   parade of its kind in the world. The
   streets are full of people who come to
   watch and CHEER just as they did when
   the famous Dick Whittington was Lord
   Mayor in 1397. Nowadays, the crowds
   BLOW WHISTLES and wave UNION JACK
   flags. At the end of the parade there
   is a SPECTACULAR firework DISPLAY.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Lord Mer sayli — 1215-yilda boshlangan va
   har yili noyabrda o'tkaziladigan rang-barang
   London an'anasi. Lord Mer — shahar haqida
   muhim qarorlar qabul qiladigan shaxs.

   Sayl davomida u katta saylning eng oldida,
   oltin aravada London markazidan o'tadi.
   Saylda askarlar, yurish orkestrlari, otlar
   va yorqin bo'yalgan bezakli aravalar bor.
   Odamlar go'zal liboslar kiyib, orkestr
   sadolarini tinglagancha arava ortidan
   ergashadi.

   Butun kortej qariyb to'rt kilometr uzunlikda.
   Bu — dunyodagi shu turdagi eng katta sayl.
   Ko'chalar tomosha qilib olqishlaydigan
   odamlarga to'la — xuddi 1397-yilda mashhur
   Dik Uittington Lord Mer bo'lgan paytdagi
   kabi. Hozirgi kunda olomon hushtak chalib,
   Britaniya bayrog'ini silkitadi. Sayl oxirida
   ajoyib salyut bo'ladi.'


⚠ 'THE UNION JACK' NIMA:

  'the Union Jack' = Buyuk Britaniya
  bayrog'i (ko'k fonda oq va qizil xochlar).

  ⚠ Uch bayroqning birlashmasi:
     Angliya (qizil xoch)
     Shotlandiya (oq qiya xoch)
     Irlandiya (qizil qiya xoch)

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 'UNION' (birlashma).


⚠ 'A FLOAT' — QIZIQ SO'Z:

  'a float' = sayldagi bezatilgan arava
  (yuk mashinasi ustiga qurilgan bezak)

  ⚠ 'to float' = suzib yurmoq (suvda)

  ⚠ Nomi shundan: arava sekin, go'yo
  suzib borayotgandek harakatlanadi.


⚠ 'A BAND' — KO'P MA'NOLI:

     'a band' = orkestr, musiqa guruhi
        'marching bands' = yurish
           orkestrlari
     'a band' = tasma, bog'ich
     'a rubber band' = rezinka

exercises.instructionUz: 2-MATN — MAY BAYRAMLARI: Britaniyada 1-may 'May Day' deb ataladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKINChI MATN — MAY FESTIVALS.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  '1st May is called May Day in Britain
   and there are lots of different
   TRADITIONS and festivals to CELEBRATE
   the first day of spring.

   In many English towns and villages the
   local people dance around a maypole
   which is decorated with flowers and
   RIBBONS. They also choose a PRETTY
   young girl to be the May Queen. She
   then LEADS a parade around the streets
   and Morris Dancers wear flowers and
   bells and perform a special dance.

   In Padstow in Cornwall, the May Day
   celebrations include the Hobby Horse
   Festival. Two men wear costumes and
   MASKS and go around the town followed
   by dancers and musicians.

   Well dressing is another May Day
   tradition. Villagers decorate the
   drinking wells with pictures made from
   CLAY and flowers and people come from
   far away to admire them.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Britaniyada 1-may "May Day" deb ataladi
   va bahorning birinchi kunini nishonlash
   uchun turli an'ana va bayramlar bor.

   Ko'plab ingliz shaharcha va qishloqlarida
   mahalliy aholi gullar va lentalar bilan
   bezatilgan may ustuni atrofida raqsga
   tushadi. Ular yana chiroyli yosh qizni May
   malikasi qilib tanlashadi. So'ng u ko'chalar
   bo'ylab saylga boshchilik qiladi, Morris
   raqqoslari esa gul va qo'ng'iroq taqib,
   maxsus raqs ijro etishadi.

   Kornuolldagi Padstou shahrida May kuni
   tantanalariga Hobby Horse bayrami ham
   kiradi. Ikki erkak libos va niqob kiyib,
   raqqoslar va musiqachilar hamrohligida
   shahar aylanadi.

   Quduq bezash — May kunining yana bir
   an'anasi. Qishloq aholisi ichimlik
   quduqlarini loy va gullardan yasalgan
   suratlar bilan bezatadi, odamlar esa
   ularni tomosha qilgani uzoqdan kelishadi.'


⚠⚠ 'A HOBBY HORSE' — 6-BANDDAGI TUZOQ:

  'a hobby horse' — HAQIQIY OT EMAS!

  Bu — odam kiyadigan, ot ShAKLIDAGI
  libos yoki tayoqqa o'rnatilgan ot boshi.

  ⚠ Matnning o'zi buni aytadi:
  'Two men wear COSTUMES and MASKS'.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 162-betdagi 6-band
  ('There are horses in the procession')
  javobi M emas, L.

  ⚠ 'a hobby' = mashg'ulot, ermak —
  so'z shundan kelib chiqqan (bolalar
  o'yinchog'i bo'lgan).


⚠ 'MORRIS DANCERS' KIM:

  Angliyaning qadimiy xalq raqs guruhlari.

  ⚠ Oq kiyim kiyib, oyoqlariga
  QO'NG'IROQ bog'lashadi, qo'llarida
  ro'molcha yoki tayoq bo'ladi.

  ⚠ Matnda: 'wear flowers and BELLS'.


⚠ 'WELL DRESSING' — QIZIQ AN'ANA:

  'a well' = QUDUQ
  'to dress' = kiyintirmoq, bezamoq

  ⚠ 'well dressing' = quduqni bezash.

  Qishloq aholisi ichimlik quduqlarini
  loy taxta ustiga gul barglaridan surat
  yasab bezatadi.

  ⚠⚠ ADAShTIRMANG:
     'a well' = quduq (OT)
     'well' = yaxshi (RAVISh)
     'Well, ...' = 'xo'sh, ...' (kirish so'z)

exercises.instructionUz: 3-MATN — COWES HAFTALIGI: Uayt oroli — Angliyaning janubiy sohilidagi kichik orol.
exercises.explanationUz:
UChINChI MATN — COWES WEEK.

  ⚠ Sarlavhasi 162-betda (pushti harflar
  bilan), matni esa shu betda.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'The Isle of Wight is a small island on
   the south coast of England. The sea
   around the island is PERFECT for
   SAILING. Perhaps that's why the small
   port of Cowes has become one of the
   most important centres for yachting in
   the world.

   The HIGHLIGHT of the year is Cowes
   Week, which takes place in early August
   and DATES BACK to 1826. More than 1,000
   boats come to Cowes for the many
   different RACES. Thousands of people
   watch from the port or from one of the
   hundreds of SPECTATOR boats. After each
   day's sailing, there are lots of yacht
   club parties, balls and PUBLIC events.
   On the last day there is a huge
   firework display. Members of the royal
   family come to visit and everybody has
   a great time on this FRIENDLY and
   beautiful island.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Uayt oroli — Angliyaning janubiy
   sohilidagi kichik orol. Orol atrofidagi
   dengiz yelkanda suzish uchun mukammal.
   Ehtimol shuning uchun Cowes degan kichik
   port dunyodagi eng muhim yaxta sporti
   markazlaridan biriga aylangan.

   Yilning eng yorqin voqeasi — Cowes
   haftaligi; u avgust boshida o'tkaziladi
   va 1826-yilga borib taqaladi. Turli
   poygalar uchun Cowesga mingdan ortiq
   qayiq keladi. Minglab odamlar portdan
   yoki yuzlab tomoshabin qayiqlaridan biridan
   tomosha qiladi. Har kungi suzishdan keyin
   yaxta klubi ziyofatlari, ballar va ommaviy
   tadbirlar bo'ladi. Oxirgi kuni ulkan salyut
   bo'ladi. Qirol oilasi a'zolari ham tashrif
   buyuradi va bu mehmondo'st, go'zal orolda
   hamma zavq oladi.'


⚠ 'THE ISLE OF WIGHT':

  'an isle' = orol (she'riy/eski shakl)
  'an island' = orol (oddiy shakl)

  ⚠ Ikkalasida ham 's' JIM!
     'isle' [ayl]
     'island' [AY-lənd]

  ⚠ Joy nomlarida 'Isle' saqlanib qolgan:
     the Isle of Wight
     the Isle of Man


⚠⚠ 'DATES BACK TO' — MUHIM IBORA:

  'Cowes Week ... DATES BACK TO 1826'
     = 1826-yilga borib taqaladi

  ⚠ 'to date back to' = ... dan beri
  mavjud bo'lmoq, tarixi shundan
  boshlanmoq.

  ⚠ HOZIRGI ZAMONDA ishlatiladi:
     'It DATES back to 1826.'  ✓
     'It DATED back to 1826.'  ✗


⚠ 'THE HIGHLIGHT' = ENG YORQIN VOQEA:

  'high' + 'light' = 'yuqori' + 'yorug'lik'

  ⚠ 'the highlight of the year' = yilning
  eng yodda qoladigan voqeasi.

  ⚠ 'to highlight' (fe'l) = bo'yab
  belgilamoq — 162-betdagi 'highlighted
  words' shundan.


⚠ 'A RACE' — IKKI MA'NO:

     'a race' = POYGA
        'many different races' ← bu yerda
     'a race' = IRQ, xalq
        'people of all races'

  ⚠ Kontekstga qarab aniqlanadi.


⚠ 'MORE THAN 1,000' va 'HUNDREDS OF':

     'MORE THAN 1,000 boats' — ANIQ raqam
     'HUNDREDS OF spectator boats' —
        noaniq ko'plik
     'THOUSANDS OF people' — noaniq ko'plik

  ⚠ QOIDA:
     aniq raqam bilan → 'a thousand',
        'two hundred' (KO'PLIK YO'Q)
     'of' bilan → 'thousandS of',
        'hundredS of' (KO'PLIK BOR)


⚠ 'EACH DAY'S SAILING' — EGALIK:

  'After each DAY'S sailing'
     = har kungi suzishdan keyin

  ⚠ Vaqt bildiruvchi so'zlarda ham egalik
  apostrofi ishlatiladi:
     today's lesson  = bugungi dars
     a day's work    = bir kunlik ish
     two weeks' time = ikki hafta


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an isle      = orol
  an island    = orol
  a coast      = sohil
  perfect for  = ... uchun mukammal
  sailing      = yelkanda suzish
  perhaps      = ehtimol
  a highlight  = eng yorqin voqea
  to date back to = ... ga borib taqalmoq
  a race       = poyga; irq
  a spectator  = tomoshabin
  a ball       = bal (raqs kechasi)
  public       = ommaviy
  the royal family = qirol oilasi
  a member     = a'zo
  friendly     = mehmondo'st

exercises.instructionUz: Bayramlar taqvimi: Britaniyaning yana bir necha muhim bayram va tadbirlari.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 12 OY — 12 TA BRITANIYA BAYRAMI.

  Kitob har oyga bittadan tadbir bergan.


⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI:

  Taqvimda: 'September — BRAEMER Royal
  Highland Gathering'

  ⚠ To'g'ri yozilishi — BRAEMAR.

  Bu — Shotlandiyaning Aberdinshir
  hududidagi qishloq nomi. O'yinlar ham
  shu nom bilan ataladi.

  ⚠ Rasmni kattalashtirib tekshirdim:
  kitobda aniq 'Braemer' bosilgan.


HAR BAYRAM HAQIDA QISQAChA:

  YANVAR — Burns Night (25-yanvar)
     Shotland shoiri Robert Berns
     tug'ilgan kun. Shotlandiyada
     an'anaviy taom ('haggis') yeyiladi
     va uning she'rlari o'qiladi.

  FEVRAL — Pancake Day
     Ro'zadan oldingi seshanba. Uyda
     qo'ymoch (pancake) pishiriladi.
     ⚠ Ba'zi joylarda 'pancake race' —
     qo'lda tovada qo'ymoch bilan yugurish
     poygasi bo'ladi!

  MART — Mother's Day
     ⚠ Britaniyada MARTDA (Amerikada esa
     mayda!) — bu farq muhim.

  APREL — April Fool's Day (1-aprel)
     Aldash kuni. ⚠ Hazil faqat TUShGACHA
     qilinadi — bu qadimiy qoida.

  MAY — Brighton Arts Festival
     Brayton shahridagi san'at festivali.

  IYUN — Royal Ascot Races
     Mashhur ot poygasi. ⚠ Ayollarning
     katta shlyapalari bilan mashhur.

  IYUL — Henley Royal Regatta
     Temza daryosidagi eshkak eshish
     poygasi.

  AVGUST — Notting Hill Carnival
     Londondagi Karib havzasi karnavali —
     Yevropadagi eng yirik ko'cha
     bayramlaridan biri.

  SENTABR — Braemar Royal Highland
     Gathering
     Shotland tog' o'yinlari: og'ir tosh
     otish, qarag'ay ustuni ag'darish,
     volinka chalish.
     ⚠ Kitobda 'Braemer' deb xato yozilgan.

  OKTABR — Halloween (31-oktabr)
     Qovoqdan chiroq yasash, liboslar.

  NOYABR — Bonfire Night (5-noyabr)
     'Guy Fawkes Night' ham deyiladi.
     Gulxan va salyut.
     ⚠ 162-betdagi Lord Mayor's Show ham
     noyabrda!

  DEKABR — New Year's Eve (31-dekabr)
     Yangi yil arafasi.


⚠ OYLAR — HAR DOIM BOSh HARF BILAN:

     January, February, March...

  ⚠ Kunlar ham: Monday, Tuesday...
  ⚠ O'zbek tilida kichik harf bilan.


⚠ 'EVE' NIMA:

  'an eve' = arafa (bayramdan oldingi
  kech)

  O'ZBEKISTON uchun BAYRAMLAR TAQVIMINI
  tuzish.


1-SAVOL: 'Which festival interests you
          most?'

  ⚠ 'to INTEREST' bu yerda FE'L:
     'The festival INTERESTS me.'
     = Bayram meni qiziqtiradi.

  ⚠ Boshqacha aytish mumkin:
     'I am INTERESTED IN the festival.'
     ⚠ 'interested IN' — 'in' bilan!

     'The festival that interests me most

     'In picture D I can see a lot of
      people dancing around a tall pole.
      There are children and adults. The
      pole is decorated with long ribbons
      and the dancers are holding them.
      They are wearing red and white
      clothes. It is a sunny day and there
      are old houses behind them.

      This is a maypole dance. It happens
      on the 1st of May to celebrate the
      first day of spring.'

  ⚠ RASMNI TASVIRLASh QOLIPI:
     'In the picture I can see ...'
     'There is / There are ...'
     'He/She is wearing ...'
     'In the background there is ...'

  ⚠ Rasmda nima BO'LAYOTGANINI aytganda
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS ishlatiladi:
     'They ARE DANCING.'

                 (1-sentabr)

                 (1-oktabr)

                 (8-dekabr)

     hayiti — oy taqvimi bo'yicha, sanasi
     har yili o'zgaradi.


  NAMUNA TASVIR (Navro'z):

     'The most important festival in
      Uzbekistan is Navruz. It takes place
      on the 21st of March and it
      celebrates the first day of spring.

      Navruz dates back thousands of
      years. People clean their houses,
      wear new clothes and visit their
      relatives.

      The special dish is SUMALAK. Women
      cook it all night in a big pot and
      sing songs while they stir it.

      There are also concerts, games and
      horse races in the streets.'

  ⚠⚠ NAVRUZ — May Day bilan JUDA O'XShASh:

     • ikkalasi ham BAHOR bayrami
     • ikkalasi ham birinchi bahor kunini

     • ikkalasida ham raqs, musiqa va
       maxsus taom bor

  javobni ancha kuchli qiladi.

  'It takes place on the ... of ...'
  'It dates back to ...'
  'The highlight of the festival is ...'
  'People wear ... and eat ...'
  'It is similar to ... in Britain.'

     'on the 21st of March'  (BrE)
     'on March 21st'         (AmE)

  ⚠ 'IN' + oy ('in March').

Mustaqillik kuni (1-sentabr), Konstitutsiya

exercises.instructionUz: MADANIYAT LAVHALARI
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — YANGI BO'LIM MUQOVASI.

  Photo File Section 144-bet bilan
  tugadi. Endi yangi bo'lim boshlanadi:

     CULTURE CLIPS

  Betda mashq ham, bet raqami ham yo'q.


⚠ 'CULTURE CLIPS' NIMA DEGANI:

  'culture'  = madaniyat
  'a clip'   = qisqa lavha, parcha

  Ya'ni: MADANIYAT LAVhALARI —
  turli xalqlar hayotidan qisqa
  hikoyalar.

  ⚠ 'a clip' ning boshqa ma'nolari:
     • qisqichcha (qog'oz qisqichi)
     • video lavha ('a video clip')
     • qirqmoq ('to clip')

  ⚠ Bu yerda — VIDEO LAVhA ma'nosida:
  qisqa, qiziqarli parcha.


MUQOVADAGI TO'RT TASVIR:

  1) XITOY PAGODASI
     Ko'p qavatli ibodatxona-minora.
     Qayrilgan cherepitsali tomlar, qizil
     yog'och devorlar, eshik ustida
     xitoycha yozuv.
     → O'ZGA MADANIYAT

  2) DENGIZ KOMPASI
     Rumbalari ko'rinadi: N, NE, E, SE,
     S, SW, W, NW.
     → YO'NALISh, SAYOhAT

  3) TEZYURAR PAROM
     Bortida 'Stena Line' va 'LYNX'.
     → SAYOhAT, DENGIZ

  4) SALYUTLAR
     Oq-ko'k uchqunlar.
     → BAYRAM

  ⚠ To'rt tasvir birgalikda bo'lim
  mavzusini ochadi: sayohat, bayram va
  o'zga xalqlar hayoti.


⚠ KOMPAS RUMBALARI (muqovadan):

     N   = North      = shimol
     S   = South      = janub
     E   = East       = sharq
     W   = West       = g'arb

     NE  = North-East = shimoli-sharq
     SE  = South-East = janubi-sharq
     SW  = South-West = janubi-g'arb
     NW  = North-West = shimoli-g'arb

  ⚠ Ingliz tilida SHIMOL-JANUB oldin,
  SHARQ-G'ARB keyin aytiladi:
     'north-east'  ✓
     'east-north'  ✗

  ⚠ Tomon nomlaridan sifat yasaladi:
     north → NORTHERN (shimoliy)
     south → SOUTHERN (janubiy)
     east  → EASTERN  (sharqiy)
     west  → WESTERN  (g'arbiy)

  ⚠ 142-betda 'northern Belgium' iborasi
  shundan.


⚠ 'STENA LINE' va 'LYNX':

  'Stena Line' — Shvetsiya-Britaniya
  parom kompaniyasi.

  'Lynx' — uning tezyurar katamaranlari
  nomi.

  ⚠ 'a lynx' = silovsin (yovvoyi mushuk).
  Kemalarga tezlik va chaqqonlikni
  bildirish uchun hayvon nomi berilgan.

  ⚠ 'a ferry' = parom (odam va mashina
  tashuvchi kema).


COURSEBOOK'NING QO'ShIMChA BO'LIMLARI:

  116-bet      Irregular Verbs
                 (111 ta noto'g'ri fe'l)
  119-124-bet  Word List
                 (unit bo'yicha so'zlar)
  131-144-bet  Photo File Section
                 (rangli rasmli varaqlar)
  shu bo'lim   Culture Clips
                 (madaniyat lavhalari)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  culture     = madaniyat
  cultural    = madaniy
  a clip      = qisqa lavha; qisqichcha
  a pagoda    = pagoda (xitoy minorasi)
  a compass   = kompas
  a ferry     = parom
  fireworks   = salyut, mushakbozlik
  north       = shimol
  south       = janub
  east        = sharq
  west        = g'arb
  a lynx      = silovsin

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning asosiy diqqatga sazovor joylaridan biri — Stenli Park; u yerda qumli plyajlar va ko'llar bor.

sentencePatterns.explanationUz:

sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'always' — asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN.
⚠ 'don't' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Chinatown really comes to life during the New Year celebrations.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Chinese Gate, which is a beautiful entrance to Chinatown, is green and red.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Although it is called Chinatown, these businesses are from all over the Far East.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: London's Chinatown is decorated with lanterns and flags.

sentencePatterns.formula: People see [nima] as a symbol of [nima].

sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
